prompt: How many activation sessions started in each month of 2025? Count a session in the UTC month of its first event, and work the gaps out over each user's whole history, 2024 included. A user's first activation event starts a session, and an event more than 30 minutes after the same user's previous event starts a new one; an event exactly 30 minutes later stays in the same session. Measure each gap as the time between the two moments in event_ts, a UTC instant. When two events of a user share a moment, take them in event_name order, A to Z. Return two columns, in this order: month_start, the first day of the month, and sessions. Return one row for each month of 2025 with at least one session start. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, read each user's previous event over all of the data, then count the 2025 session starts by month.
Filter to 2025 only after the window has run, or the first 2025 event of a 2024 user looks like a new user.
why_this_works: Gaps come from each user's full history, so a 2025 event close to a late 2024 event stays in its session and only real starts count.
